contexts.title: Harbor Loft Climbing membership terms and fees
contexts.text:
HARBOR LOFT CLIMBING - MEMBERSHIP TERMS AND FEES
Effective 1 March 2026. Applies to both Harbor Loft locations (Quayside and Millrace).

1. Monthly memberships
- Standard (all hours): $64 per month.
- Off-Peak (weekdays before 4 pm, weekends after 6 pm): $46 per month.
- Student (valid student ID, all hours): $52 per month.
Dues are billed on the 1st of each month. New members pay a one-time $25 joining fee, waived during promotional weeks.

2. Annual prepay
Pay 12 months up front and receive 10% off the monthly rate for your plan. Annual prepay is non-refundable after the first 14 days.

3. Freezing your membership
Members may freeze for one to three full calendar months in any 12-month period. A frozen month is billed a $12 freeze fee on the 1st of that month instead of your normal dues. Each freeze request also carries a one-time $10 setup fee, charged when the freeze is booked. Freezes must be requested by the 25th of the month before the first frozen month; late requests start the following month. Medical freezes with a doctor's note have no setup fee.

4. Cancelling
Give 30 days' written notice through the member portal or at the front desk. Your final month's dues are charged as normal. Cancelling during a freeze ends the freeze on the cancellation date.

5. Guest passes
Day pass for non-members: $18 on weekdays, $22 on Saturdays, Sundays and public holidays. Member-accompanied guests pay $14 any day (limit two guests per visit). A 5-visit punch card costs $80 and never expires. All guests sign a waiver and watch the 6-minute safety video before climbing.

6. Rentals
Shoes $6, harness $5, chalk bag $3, or all three for $11 per visit. Day lockers are free; overnight locker hire is $15 per month.

7. Classes
Intro to Bouldering (90 minutes): $38. Lead climbing course (three sessions): $165, members $140. Youth squad terms are priced separately; ask the front desk.

8. Payment problems
If a dues payment fails we retry after 3 days. A second failure adds an $8 admin fee and suspends check-in until the balance is cleared.

Questions: members@harborloft.example or the front desk at either location.
contexts.notes: SQGEN-005: Standard member froze June+July, booked in early May (before the 25th cut-off), charged 86. Policy: 2 x $12 + $10 setup = $34. 86 = one month at full Standard dues ($64) + one $12 freeze month + $10 setup, which only happens for a LATE request; she booked in time, so the charge does not reconcile (overcharge $52). The 'late requests start the following month' clause is a tempting but factually excluded justification. SQGEN-006: non-member Saturday day pass is $22; $18 (weekday) and $14 (member-accompanied) are neighbouring-row traps.
